messages:
anna (customer): Hey team — signed up yesterday but my free trial credits never showed up after I verified my email. account id `acct_1234`. Can someone check? :confused:

elaine (support): Sorry about that — can you DM me the email you used? Did you see any banner about credits or a payment hold?

anna (customer): Sent DM (anna+trial@example.com). No banner, just ‘account active’ email. I added a card but no charge. Region: HR (Croatia). Signup IP was FR.

billing-bot: Automated check result: trial_eligibility=FAILED; gate=REGIONAL_BIN_MISMATCH; reason=PM_BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.

matt_s: @elaine fyi — we recently tightened BIN checks for EU to reduce fraud. That can block trial grants when billing country != BIN country. @anna, did you get any 3DS prompt during card add?

anna (customer): I didn't see a 3DS popup. Card works elsewhere. Last4 is 4242.

elaine (support): Thanks. I can see the gating flag on the account. Policy: trial auto-grant requires either (a) verified email + supported BIN OR (b) manual ops review for cross-border BINs. I'll escalate for a manual grant.

ops_jordan: Looping in billing ops — @billing can you start a manual review for `acct_1234`? Please check BIN 400000 vs billing country HR. Customer has verified email.

billing: Hi @ops_jordan, @elaine — please paste the customer email and last 4 of card in channel so we have a record, and we'll perform a BIN override if review passes. ETA ~ 2–4 hours.

elaine (support): Email: anna+trial@example.com, acct: `acct_1234`, card last4: 4242, BIN: 400000, signup IP FR, billing country HR. Verified email timestamp: 2024-11-09T12:04:00Z.

billing: Received. Running fraud & BIN checks, then manual KYC look. If approved, we'll push 1000 trial credits and tag account `trial_granted_manual`.

anna (customer): Appreciate it. Is there any temporary way I can run some API tests while this is pending?

matt_s: You can do very small tests via the local dev key with the `--dev` flag but it has strict rate limits and won't help for larger integration tests. Otherwise we need ops to push credits.

billing: Manual review complete — cleared. Applied 1000 trial credits to `acct_1234` (tx `tx_7890`). Marked account `trial_granted_manual`.

anna (customer): I can see the credits now — thank you! :tada: That fixes my test runs.

elaine (support): Awesome — closing the ticket from our side. We'll also add a note to the signup flow to prompt EU users about BIN/3DS if billing country differs.

ops_jordan: Filed a short playbook update: recommend adding an inline prompt for 3DS if BIN country mismatch is detected, and include a one-click ‘request manual review’ for support teams.

support-bot: Thread marked resolved by elaine. Closed.
